messages:
maria: FYI infra alert — EU (eu-west-1) warm-pool launch failing since 08:12 UTC. ~30% of GPU nodes stuck in pending with decrypt errors.
infra-bot: [ALERT] keystore.decrypt failed for instance-profile: gpu-launcher-eu: AccessDenied
devin: seeing same; NAT gateway hitting conntrack + firewall egress tightened in subnet-seg-3; packets dropped to kms.private.redwood.
ashok: confirmed: new KMS key policy pushed an explicit Deny for cross-account role ARNs; looks like the instance role used by bootstrapper isn't in allow list.
taylor: also found: subnet affinity change (terraform) moved staging warm pool into private subnets w/o SSM endpoint so bootstrapper can't reach keystore.
maria: minimal reproduction: launch an instance in sub-net-id subnet-3, run `curl https://kms.internal.redwood/decrypt` -> 403
maria: logs: ```ERROR AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::111111111:assumed-role/bootstrapper-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:222222:key/abcd``` 
devin: cost note: we've been overprovisioning EU warm-pool for QPS headroom. Failed launches are holding capacity and we're getting charged for pending EBS + IPs (~$1.2k/day reported).
kevin: ML infra impact — several model endpoints in EU are scaling down to fallback hosted models; latency up ~120ms tail.
nashok: propose short-term mitigation: rollback the Deny and patch KMS policy to explicit Allow for bootstrapper-role with condition on SourceVpc and SourceIp.
taylor: agree. Also will add SSM VPC endpoint to subnets and pin warm-pool placement to public control-plane subnets until we reconcile terraform drift.
maria: dev plan: 1) rollback KMS policy (hotfix) 2) add SSM endpoint + patch terraform 3) run canary in eu-west-1a 4) audit IAM role boundary for bootstrapper 5) cost reclaim task.
devin: can someone own the rollback? @ashok ?
ashok: I'll do rollback now and post policy diff.
infra-bot: deployment started: kms-policy-rollforward job #5678 by ashok at 08:48 UTC
ashok: policy diff: ```- {"Effect":"Deny","Principal":"*","Action":"kms:*","Condition":{"StringNotEquals":{"aws:PrincipalArn":"arn:aws:iam::222222:role/bootstrapper-role"}}} 
+ replaced with explicit Allow for arn:aws:iam::222222:role/bootstrapper-role and condition on aws:SourceVpc and aws:SourceIp``` 
maria: after rollback, warm-pool started launches in eu-west-1b, healthchecks passed. queue drained.
taylor: created terraform PR #422 to add SSM endpoint + pinned subnet placement; linking: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/422
devin: I'll open a billing ticket for reclaiming leftover EBS snapshots and IPs; estimate $900 reclaimable.
kevin: let's schedule follow-up in eng-infra tomorrow 10:30 to review permanent fixes and routing tests.
maria: thanks all. mark as resolved for now, keeping monitoring for 1hr. :thumbsup:
